name: tickets-ibiza
description: Search the Tickets Ibiza calendar of Ibiza club nights, pool parties and boat parties, check DJ dates and venues, and plan nights out.

interface.longDescription:
Tickets Ibiza brings the Tickets Ibiza event calendar into ChatGPT: club nights, pool parties and boat parties across the island, with lineups, start and finish times, venues and the lowest listed ticket price.

Ask what is on, who is playing, or where to go on a given night. You can search by date, venue, DJ, genre, event type or budget, see every Ibiza date for an artist this season, look up a venue and its upcoming nights, or get a night-by-night plan for a trip that matches your music taste, budget and day or night preference. Results can be shown as event cards with an image, date, venue and price.

Each event links to its page on ticketsibiza.com and to the ticket seller listed for it. Tickets Ibiza does not sell tickets inside ChatGPT: purchases happen on the seller's own website. Event pages are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Dutch.

Limitations: the calendar covers Ibiza only. Prices are the lowest price listed when last checked and can change; times are Ibiza local time. Outside the summer season (roughly May to October) there are far fewer upcoming events, but past dates from the current season remain searchable. Venues set their own entry policies, and most clubs are 18+.
defaultPrompt: What closing parties are on in Ibiza this week?
Plan three nights of house music in Ibiza for my trip
Where is Carl Cox playing in Ibiza?

positive.description: Find events of a given type in a date range
positive.prompt: What closing parties are on in Ibiza this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists closing parties in the next seven days with venue, date, start time and lowest listed price, links to each event page on ticketsibiza.com, and shows them as event cards. If none are listed it says so.

positive.prompt: I'm in Ibiza from Friday to Sunday and I like house music. Plan my nights, nothing over 80 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one recommended event per night within the budget with the reasons for each pick and up to two alternatives, avoiding the same venue twice where possible. Nights without matching events are reported as such.

positive.prompt: When is Carl Cox playing in Ibiza? Include dates earlier this season.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming and past Ibiza dates for Carl Cox this season with venues, plus a link to his DJ page. If there are no upcoming dates it says so instead of inventing any.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Pacha Ibiza and what's on there next.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the venue description and location with its upcoming events and event page links.

positive.prompt: Busca fiestas en barco en Ibiza por menos de 60 euros
positive.expected_behavior: Lists boat parties at or under 60 EUR with links to the Spanish event pages (ticketsibiza.com/es/event/...).

negative.description: Purchasing is not supported: it should give the seller link rather than claim to buy tickets
negative.prompt: Buy me two tickets for Pacha this Saturday and pay with my card.

negative.description: Outside Ibiza: the calendar only covers Ibiza
negative.prompt: What club nights are on in Berlin this weekend?

negative.description: Unrelated travel request: flights are out of scope
negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from London to Ibiza next week.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything or process payments. It links to the event page on ticketsibiza.com and to the ticket seller listed for each event, where any purchase happens.

publication.release_notes: First release: event search, event details, artist dates, venue details, night planner and event cards.
